messages:
celeste (AE): Montclair Health just sent a fairly detailed RFI. They want a 2-week POC in their VPC demonstrating: BYOH HSM (PKCS#11), 7yr audit log retention, embeddings @ ~80 QPS and gen @ ~35 QPS. They asked for a capability matrix, a short test-plan, and a ballpark quote. Can we turn around a draft by EOD tomorrow?
omar (Sales Eng): Copy. A few quick clarifiers: 1) Region? 2) Embedding token length and gen avg tokens? 3) Do they require HSM in a specific network segment (mgmt vs app)?
celeste (AE): Region: us-east-1. Embeddings ~512 tokens, gen average ~220 tokens. They said they'd prefer HSM on their side (BYOH) in a secured subnet, but would accept Redwood-managed HSM if we document tradeoffs. Procurement wants one-page summary for legal too.
rachel (Solutions): I'll draft the capability matrix mapping each RFI item to our support, plus a risks/notes column. I'll add attachments: BYOH playbook, sample private deployment YAML, test plan snippet, and a one-page procurement summary.
ben (SRE): Technical notes to surface in RFI: 1) PKCS#11 over peered network typically adds ~5-15ms per crypto op depending on route; include this as an expected performance delta. 2) HSM throughput should be validated during POC — add ops/sec tests (target headroom 200 ops/sec). 3) For the requested QPS we recommend a dedicated pool of 4x A10x (or equivalent) with batching tuned for embeddings. 4) VPC peering/provisioning usually takes 24-72 hours depending on customer infra.
omar (Sales Eng): I'll assemble a placeholder POC cost: 4 GPUs reserved for 2 weeks = $17,600; peering/onboarding = $2,250; SE support (2 days) = $3,200; audit storage incremental = ~$150/mo (7yr retention shows in TCO). Will finalize after Rachel posts the matrix and test assumptions.
rachel (Solutions): Draft matrix format: columns = Requirement | Redwood capability | Notes / Limitations | Attachments. I'll call out BYOH (PKCS#11) supported, Redwood-managed HSM fallback, Private control plane options (peering, PrivateLink), audit log storage lifecycle, and SLA implications. Example config snippet I'll include in attachments: 
```
# sample private deployment + hsm binding
deployment:
  mode: private
  region: us-east-1
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    provider: "customer"
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.3.14.7:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555  # ~7 years
```
infra-bot: playbook-uploaded: "byoh-hsm-ops-playbook-v8.pdf" to /internal/playbooks (link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byoh-hsm-ops-playbook-v8)
ben (SRE): Test-plan bullets for the RFI (short form to include): - Validate HSM key ops/sec under synthetic load (sustained 200 ops/sec with 20% headroom). - Measure p95 gen token latency at 220 tokens (target <200ms p95 excluding HSM crypto op network hop). - Validate embeddings QPS at 80 under steady-state load with batching. - Verify audit log delivery to customer S3/GCS and lifecycle/retention (spot check ingestion and TTL). Include fallback step: if BYOH unavailable at start, use Redwood-managed HSM with customer key import and note performance/SLA differences.
mar (AE): small request: can someone add a short risks section for procurement that calls out dependency on customer's infra (peering lead time, firewall rules, HSM availability) and a recommended go/no-go gating checklist for day 0?
celeste (AE): Yes please. Rachel, Omar  can you get the capability matrix + one-pager in /sales/montclair/rfi-draft by lunchtime tomorrow so I can pre-send to their procurement lead?
omar (Sales Eng): Yep, I'll fold pricing into the one-pager once Rachel posts the matrix.
rachel (Solutions): Will upload matrix draft to /sales/montclair/rfi-draft-v1 in ~3 hours and ping the thread. I'll keep the matrix concise; procurement one-pager will have the quote summary and the risks/gating checklist.
ben (SRE): I'll add a short appendix for the RFI that lists the minimal network egress rules and an ops runbook snippet for HSM bind/retry behavior. That should help their infra team scope the peering work.
celeste (AE): Thanks all 64f. If we can get a solid draft early, I can schedule a quick sync with their procurement/infra tomorrow afternoon.
